findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 18 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 23 questions numbered 1-23; by section: 18.1 2, 18.2 4, 18.3 2, 18.4 1, 18.5 1, 18.6 3, 18.7 3, 18.8 2, 18.9 2, 18.10 3.

Theory parts on the 3d series and configurations, physical and chemical properties, variable oxidation states, catalysis, ligands and components of a complex, geometries, ligand effect on ΔE and colour, ligand exchange of Cu(II) and Co(II), Kstab and the chelating effect, geometrical and optical isomerism; numericals on formula and charge of complexes, ΔE = hc/λ, Kstab and dilution, and E°cell with titration amounts for MnO₄⁻/C₂O₄²⁻, MnO₄⁻/Fe²⁺ and Cu²⁺/I⁻. All numbers recomputed in Python; none repeats the exercise's constructed-response or descriptive questions. Book corrections followed: E°(CO₂/C₂O₄²⁻) = −0.49 V, E°cell = +2.01 V, 16H⁺ and 10CO₂; E°(Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺) = +0.77 V, E°cell = +0.75 V, 8H⁺ and 5Fe³⁺; ligand charge −6 in [Fe(CN)₆]⁴⁻; Cu(II) ammonia complex [Cu(NH₃)₄(H₂O)₂]²⁺; two isomers for [MA₄B₂]; tetrahedral examples only as d⁷ [CoCl₄]²⁻ and d⁵ [MnCl₄]²⁻.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
